description: Use it when the person asks where this site's yachts leave from, or a place name they said is shared by two places. It answers how many regions, countries, areas, towns and bases there are, then one page of those places, each with its id and how many yachts are there now, read from the live inventory. Pass text with the name the person said to find that place on the first page, and level to list only one kind of place. When placesPage.cursor is not null, pass it as cursor for the next page. Pass an id to search_yachts as placeId to search exactly that place, for example when a name the person said is shared by two places. Arguments: text, level, cursor, limit. Any other name is refused.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous answer returned, for its next page.

limit.description: Rows per page: at most 50 without sign-in, 20 for a signed-in person.

text.description: Part of a place's name, in the person's words: only places whose name holds every word (any case).

name: list_places

counts.description: How many places of each level there are in all (region, country, area, town, base).

freshness.description: The copy of the source this answer reads.

readAt.description: When the source answered it, ISO time.

places.description: Every region, country, area, town and base, as the source links them.

id.description: Its id: the source's own; a town is "<countryId>:<city>". search takes it as placeId.

items.description: How many are based there now.

name.description: Its name, as the source writes it.

placeId.description: Its typed id, "<level>:<id>": search takes it as placeId and it names this place only.

url.description: Its page on this site, when it has one.

placesPage.description: This page: total places (of the asked level) and the cursor for the next page, null on the last.

cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

total.description: Places in all, of the asked level.

title: List places
